Individually qualifying candidates, held until the strategy gate clears: ES, NQ, YM.

All individually passing peers are retained as research candidates. There is no fixed ES, CL, or 6E preference. When a focused selection plan is present, its role-based shortlist advances first and other passing peers remain reserves. Each symbol must pass the same three core thresholds; a passing family cannot rescue a failing symbol. This shortlist covers standard futures roots in the seven groups below; ETFs, spot FX, retired contracts and micro variants are excluded.

Family breadth counts each supplied symbol with eligible results once, regardless of how many parameter sets it has. It shows transferability across the tested instruments, not proof that every instrument in that sector works. Individual passes do not prove that the same parameter combination works across the family; inspect shared profitable regions before freezing the rule for WFA. Within each group, available recent volume sorts first, highest to lowest. Missing volume never removes a passing symbol. Current liquidity snapshot: 2026-09-21; median of up to 60 daily sessions, at least 20 required, latest session no older than 7 calendar days. No minimum volume cutoff is applied. This is a volume proxy, not an execution-liquidity pass. Check spreads, depth, trading-session volume, and slippage for the actual contract and order size. It is separate from the historical optimization gate; volume counts are not risk-adjusted across different contract sizes.

Distinctiveness: not measured by optimization summaries

NG and other passing peers remain eligible for research even when another instrument leads the group; the frozen plan distinguishes nominees from reserves. To decide which add distinct strategy behavior, compare aligned, risk-normalized OOS daily strategy returns, rolling correlations, overlapping drawdowns and incremental portfolio results after costs. Underlying-price correlation alone is insufficient. Similar instruments can remain redundant; sector membership alone does not prove diversification.

Peer robustness: two routes to WFA

Sector-first: at least 3 individual passes and 50% of tested instruments. No pair or distinctness bypass. Select one representative by median CAR/MDD; within 10% use execution quality and liquidity, then lower-quartile CAR/MDD.

Research period: 2009-01-01 through 2019-01-01 (inclusive). 3 group-supported · 0 conditional · 6 held.

Strict shared-region diagnostic: at least 3 adequately sampled, behaviorally similar symbols, with at least 67% passing together in a connected parameter region covering at least 50% of the grid. Conditional: persistent distinct underlying behavior, a robust own parameter neighborhood, and at least 3 research subperiods supporting the same region. Missing strict or exception evidence holds those routes; the practical economic-group route can qualify without price data. An isolated profitable symbol is not automatically distinct.

Peers are candidate-centered: each listed peer resembles that candidate in research-period daily price returns; this does not imply every pair in the list resembles one another. Strict diagnostic similarity requires correlation ≥ 0.60 overall and in at least 75% of 126-session windows. Practical pairs use rolling similarity; their full-period correlation is advisory. Distinctness requires absolute correlation ≤ 0.35 against every configured economic comparator (missing comparator data holds the exception), with at least 3 comparators; inverse twins do not qualify. At least 90% of weekdays in the declared research span must have returns, and pairwise matched-date coverage must also meet that threshold. No grouping uses strategy profits or later OOS prices.

Production selection, execution and OOS requirements

One production symbol per group

Focused WFA shortlist: None
Production selection: None — evidence gates remain open

Peer robustness: two routes to WFA

Sector-first: at least 3 individual passes and 50% of tested instruments. No pair or distinctness bypass. Select one representative by median CAR/MDD; within 10% use execution quality and liquidity, then lower-quartile CAR/MDD.

Research period: 2009-01-01 through 2019-01-01 (inclusive). 3 group-supported · 0 conditional · 6 held.

Strict shared-region diagnostic: at least 3 adequately sampled, behaviorally similar symbols, with at least 67% passing together in a connected parameter region covering at least 50% of the grid. Conditional: persistent distinct underlying behavior, a robust own parameter neighborhood, and at least 3 research subperiods supporting the same region. Missing strict or exception evidence holds those routes; the practical economic-group route can qualify without price data. An isolated profitable symbol is not automatically distinct.

Peers are candidate-centered: each listed peer resembles that candidate in research-period daily price returns; this does not imply every pair in the list resembles one another. Strict diagnostic similarity requires correlation ≥ 0.60 overall and in at least 75% of 126-session windows. Practical pairs use rolling similarity; their full-period correlation is advisory. Distinctness requires absolute correlation ≤ 0.35 against every configured economic comparator (missing comparator data holds the exception), with at least 3 comparators; inverse twins do not qualify. At least 90% of weekdays in the declared research span must have returns, and pairwise matched-date coverage must also meet that threshold. No grouping uses strategy profits or later OOS prices.

The default is one symbol per group. A second must reduce maximum drawdown by at least 15% versus the better single-symbol drawdown, sacrificing no more than 5% of the better annualized return, under both normal and stressed costs. The 50/50 combination shares one total risk budget. It must improve at least 60% of comparison folds, pass the performance gates, fit whole-contract sizing, and demonstrate benefit again in later confirmation.

Distinctiveness nominees are hypotheses to test. Daily volume prioritizes research; dated spread, slippage, depth and order-size evidence determines execution eligibility. These are within-group selections; cross-group portfolio risk still requires review.

    Exact selection policy and calculation rules

    Require at least 252 comparison sessions across 5 non-overlapping folds; positive net and stressed CAGR; at least 60% profitable folds under both costs; drawdown ≤ 20% and drawdown duration ≤ 252 sessions under both costs. Costs are stressed by 2×. CAGR compounds daily returns and annualizes at 252 sessions. Rank by the lower quartile of fold CAGR (the worse of normal and stressed in each fold). Candidates within 1.0% CAGR points of the best score are tied; prefer lower measured cost, then slippage, spread, greater depth, then symbol name. Final confirmation requires 60 later sessions, positive normal/stressed return, and the same drawdown/duration limits. A failed confirmation does not automatically promote a backup. Policy values are editable research settings.
